title: Memory use balloons when using Find in Project
body:
### Summary

<!-- Begin your issue with a one sentence summary -->
I've recently had my Mac run out of memory due to Zed numerous times. I've isolated it down to doing searches within a project.

### Description

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open a very large project -- the project I'm using is all my work codebases in one project. (This has not been an issue for Zed in the past year ever.)
2. Open Activity Monitor so you can see Zed's memory footprint.
3. Command + Shift + F to search
4. Search for something that can be found in the project
5. Watch the memory balloon up to 10, 20, 30 GB... but maybe you'll be lucky and it's only a few GB
6. Close the search... the memory is never reclaimed

**Expected Behavior**:
A search shouldn't be generating tens of GB of memory footprint I don't think.

**Actual Behavior**:
After a while MacOS warns you that you're out of memory.

Don't think I can attach the Zed.log without breaking work security guidelines. I did not see anything relevant to searching in there.


### Zed Version and System Specs

OS: macOS 26.1

title: Encoding: Cannot convert UTF-8 with BOM to UTF-8 without BOM; no separate options in Reopen with Encoding
body:
### Reproduction steps

1. Open or create a file encoded in **UTF-8 with BOM**.
2. In Zed, press the shortcut **`Ctrl+K N`** to open the **Reopen with Encoding** panel.
3. Look for UTF-8 related encoding options.

### Current vs. Expected behavior

**Current Behavior**:
The **Reopen with Encoding** panel lists only a single `UTF-8` option that conflates **UTF-8 with BOM** and **UTF-8 without BOM**.
There is no way to explicitly switch a UTF-8 with BOM file to UTF-8 without BOM via the encoding menu.

**Expected Behavior**:
The **Reopen with Encoding** panel should provide **two distinct UTF-8 options**:
- UTF-8 (without BOM)
- UTF-8 (with BOM)
Users should be able to freely convert between UTF-8 with BOM and UTF-8 without BOM.
